source_fields.formulation: Solve the variational inequality $0\in F(x)+N_X(x)$ on a known compact convex set by returning a feasible point with small tangent residual.

assumptions.description: Fix an integer $p\ge2$. The public set $X\subseteq\mathbb R^d$ is nonempty compact convex with diameter at most D, and a feasible start x_0 is supplied. The operator is $C^{p-1}$ on an open neighborhood of X and satisfies $\langle F(x)-F(y),x-y\rangle\ge\mu\|x-y\|_2^2$ and $\|D^{p-1}F(x)-D^{p-1}F(y)\|_{\rm op}\le L_p\|x-y\|_2$ on X.
assumptions.scope: The domain stated in this clause.

assumptions.description: The positive mu and L_p are lower and upper promises, not necessarily sharp moduli. No scalar potential or bound on lower derivatives is imposed. The unique VI solution need not be a zero of F, especially at the boundary. All norms are Euclidean induced multilinear operator norms.
assumptions.scope: The domain stated in this clause.

source_fields.operation: At a feasible point return the exact complete operator jet $(F,DF,\ldots,D^{p-1}F)$. Count every call, including calls inside regularized subproblems, unsuccessful radius guesses, restarts and a final certificate check. Projections onto the known domain and exact solves of models formed only from returned jets are uncharged internal operations. An unknown-operator resolvent is not supplied for free.

feedback_quality.description: The conditional law and exact response packet are specified in the oracle paragraphs.

operations.query_signature: The query domain and ordering stated in the oracle paragraphs.

source_fields.feasibility: Return any measurable feasible point $\widehat x\in X$, possibly unqueried. The upper witness additionally returns an evaluated certificate $(\widehat x,n,F(\widehat x))$ with $n\in N_X(\widehat x)$ and a charged evaluation of F at the output.

source_fields.base_expression: The error is $r_{\rm tan}(x)=\operatorname{dist}(0,F(x)+N_X(x))$. Here $N_X(x)=\{n:\langle n,u-x\rangle\le0\text{ for all }u\in X\}$. The probability guarantee concerns this residual itself, not the root residual or distance to the solution.

source_fields.budget: One complete jet costs one query. A deterministic cap holds on every path for arbitrary measurable adaptive policies, and queries and outputs must stay feasible. The dimension-uniform comparison takes the worst case over all finite d, all legal public domains and starts, and all compatible operators.
